column2: Improve error handling in the Python scripts to manage invalid input, API failures, missing environment variables, and network connection problems.
Validate the CSV file before creating GitHub issues. Check required columns, missing task titles, and invalid rows, and display helpful error messages.
Add a mechanism to detect existing tasks before creating new GitHub issues, reducing duplicate issues when the script is run multiple times.
Extend the task creation script to assign an issue to multiple GitHub users using their usernames.
Generate a separate text or Markdown report for each task, containing its title, description, assignee, status, and GitHub issue URL.
Add priority levels such as High, Medium, and Low to the task input and reports so users can organize work by importance.
Enhance the HTML report with a clean layout, readable tables, status indicators, and clear task information.
Allow users to filter task reports by status, assignee, or priority to make it easier to find specific tasks.
Configure the reporting script to run periodically or on demand, retrieving the latest GitHub issues and updating the generated reports.
Test the complete workflow, including CSV validation, GitHub issue creation, task assignment, status tracking, and report generation. Document any issues found and their resolutions.
